title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-25 00:40:33 最新章节：第523章 他不配
content_zh:
当第一缕晨光悄然洒落，唤醒了沉睡的大地。任家镇各家各户升起袅袅炊烟，人们也将开始一天的劳作！
义庄的院子里，有个十七八岁，长着一副憨厚面容，眼睛炯炯有神的青年人影在闪动着，拳脚翻飞之间，衣袖也跟着飒飒作响，那拳脚动作看起来虎虎生威，劲道十足！
冲拳！炮拳！劈掌！扫堂腿！乌鸦坐飞机！龙卷风摧毁停车场！
一套动作结束，林道然缓缓收势，走到院子角落的石桌前，一手拿起毛巾擦了擦汗，另一手拿起茶壶给自己倒了杯凉白开。擦完汗，坐到旁边的椅子上，拿起杯子喝了起来。
时间如白驹过隙，过得真快啊！自己都已经穿越过来十八年了！
穿越前的林道然是个技术精湛的私人程序员，以给人写外挂跟第三方辅助为生。也不知道是不是外挂写多了的原因，被制裁了，因此在写完最后一个仙侠游戏的外挂后，电脑突然爆炸了！再睁眼，自己就变成了一个被丢弃在幽暗森林里的小婴儿，而眼前则是一个正气凛然的年轻道士，正伸手将他从地上抱起。
“哎！这世道！你以后就跟着我吧，做我的大弟子！道法自然，你以后就叫林道然吧！希望你能早日得道”
道士叹了口气，自言自语道。
看着道士那十分熟悉且带有安全感的面容，林道然沉默了，心里十分迷茫。
林正英？
我就写个外挂，就把我送到了九叔的怀里！不至于吧！
自那以后，林道然就跟着年轻的九叔四处游走。路上喝着九叔从不同地方讨来的奶水，看着九叔降妖除魔！内心不断的吐槽着：‘别人是嗑瓜子吃瓜看热闹，而自己则是嘬着不同的奶水看热闹，真是丢人呐！’
就在林道然8岁的时候，九叔终于选定了自己的道场，在任家镇开起了义庄。
这十年来，九叔陆续收了两个徒弟。
一个是二师弟蘑菇头文才，整天就知道吃和睡，年纪不大，长得却十分‘老练’！修炼天赋虽然一塌糊涂，但是他还懒啊！
另一个则是三师弟秋生，身强体壮，练武天赋强但修道天赋一般，主要跟着九叔修行拳脚功夫，
喝完水后，林道然抬头望天，默默地想着，穿越到这里已经十八年了，虽然一直跟着师父走南闯北的，一直努力修炼着，但是前面十几年一直在打熬身体跟道法基础，到了十四岁才开始修行茅山基础功法《上清吐纳术》。修行了四年，现在才人师五重，这修炼天赋着实一般啊！
修炼境界分为：人师，地师，天师。天师之后便是渡劫成仙，而人师之前的称为道童或者术士。每层境界都划分为九层小境界。
昨天听师父说，镇里的任老爷邀请他三天后去喝外国茶。那任发那怕火的老爹任老太爷岂不是要出来跟任发玩亲亲了！
想到这再联想到电影里任老太爷的折腾劲，连九叔这个地师八重的高手都得联合地师三重的四目师叔才能消灭它！林道然不禁感到一阵头大。

在这世界生活的十几年，林道然深知这世界没那么简单，虽然没怎么听闻过天庭的传闻，但是地府却是真实存在的啊，自家师父还是印钞司的呢！
“我这人师五重的修为，该怎么应付任老太爷啊？怕是都不够给它挠痒痒的吧！“
林道然望天无语道，接着低头又喝了一杯水，然后重重的叹了一口气。
“哎！不都说穿越者都是有系统的吗？我的系统呢？是发货地址没填好？还是被送货员截了？”
“这都十八年了！就算堵车也该到了吧？系统啊系统？你可知道我等你等到花儿都谢了！花儿都谢了！你可知不……”
就在林道然怨天怨地的时候，耳边突然响起。
叮！
【检测到宿主年龄已满十八岁，已成年，反沉迷机制失效，修道外挂系统已开启】
嗯？
“是我的错觉吗？还是我想系统想到产生幻听了？”
过了五秒，林道然怒了：“你个辣鸡系统还设置反沉迷？你就不怕我活不到反沉迷失效的时候吗？而且某鹅游戏反沉迷也还让人每天玩一个钟，你个系统竟然就这么静默了十八年！十八年啊！你知道这十八年我是怎么过的吗？我*******”
林道然内心里的小人那小嘴叭叭叭的，犹如冒蓝火的加特林一样突突突骂了系统十几秒，林道然的火气才消了，喝口水然后开始研究起了系统！
“系统，你有什么作用啊？有没有新手大礼包？”
【宿主可以通过降妖除魔，超度魂灵等行为获得功德点。功德点可以加载系统里的一系列外挂辅助宿主修道。】
【开启新手大礼包！】
content_en:
When the first ray of morning light fell quietly, it awakened the sleeping earth. Smoke is rising from every house in Renjia Town, and people are about to start their day's work!
In the courtyard of Yizhuang, a young man of seventeen or eighteen years old, with a simple face and bright eyes, was flashing. His fists and kicks were flying, and his sleeves were rustling. The movements of his fists and kicks looked very powerful and powerful!
Punch! Cannon punch! Split palms! Sweep your legs! Crows fly! Tornado destroys parking lot!
After a set of movements ended, Lin Daoran slowly stopped and walked to the stone table in the corner of the yard. He picked up a towel with one hand to wipe his sweat, and picked up a teapot with the other hand to pour himself a cup of cold water. After wiping off the sweat, he sat on the chair next to him, picked up the cup and drank.
Time flies so fast! I have already traveled through time for eighteen years!
Before time travel, Lin Daoran was a skilled private programmer who made a living by writing plug-ins and third-party assistance for people. I don’t know if it was because I wrote too many plug-ins and was sanctioned, so after I finished writing the last plug-in for the Xianxia game, my computer suddenly exploded! When he opened his eyes again, he became a little baby abandoned in the dark forest, and in front of him was an upright young Taoist priest, reaching out to pick him up from the ground.
"Hey! This is the world! You can follow me from now on and be my big disciple! Taoism is natural. From now on, you can call me Lin Daoran! I hope you can attain Taoism soon."
The Taoist priest sighed and said to himself.
Looking at the Taoist priest's very familiar and secure face, Lin Daoran fell silent, feeling very confused.
Lin Zhengying?
I just wrote a plug-in and it sent me to Uncle Jiu’s arms! Not so!
Since then, Lin Daoran has followed young Uncle Jiu around. On the way, I drank the milk that Uncle Jiu had collected from different places and watched Uncle Jiu slay demons! I kept complaining in my heart: 'Others are eating melon seeds and watching the fun, but I am watching the fun by sucking different kinds of milk. It's really embarrassing! ’
When Lin Daoran was 8 years old, Uncle Jiu finally chose his own dojo and opened a charity village in Renjia Town.
In the past ten years, Uncle Jiu has successively accepted two apprentices.
One is the second junior brother, a mushroom-headed scholar. He only knows how to eat and sleep all day long. He is not very old, but he looks very "sophisticated"! Although his cultivation talent is a mess, he is still lazy!
The other is the third junior brother Qiu Sheng, who is strong and strong, has strong talent in martial arts but average talent in cultivation. He mainly practices boxing and kicking skills with Uncle Jiu.
After drinking the water, Lin Daoran looked up at the sky and thought silently. It has been eighteen years since he traveled here. Although he has been following his master all over the world and practicing hard, he has spent the past ten years working on his body and the basics of Taoism. He only started to practice Maoshan's basic exercise "Shangqing Breathing Technique" when he was fourteen years old. After practicing for four years, I am now at the fifth level of human teacher. This cultivation talent is really average!
The realm of cultivation is divided into: human master, earth master, and heavenly master. After the Celestial Masters, those who transcend tribulations and become immortals, while those before the Human Masters are called Taoists or Warlocks. Each realm is divided into nine smaller realms.
Yesterday I heard from Master that Master Ren in the town invited him to drink foreign tea in three days. Isn't it that Ren Fa's father, Mrs. Ren, who is afraid of getting angry, is going to come out to play and kiss Ren Fa!
When I think of this, I also think of Old Master Ren’s torment in the movie. Even Uncle Jiu, a master of the eighth level of Earth Master, had to team up with Uncle Four Eyes, the third level of Earth Master, to destroy it! Lin Daoran couldn't help but feel dizzy.
After living in this world for more than ten years, Lin Daoran knows that this world is not that simple. Although he has not heard much about the heaven, the underworld is real, and his master is from the Department of Banknote Printing!
"How should I deal with Old Master Ren with my fifth-level cultivation? I'm afraid I'm not even good enough to scratch his itch!"
Lin Daoran looked at the sky and said speechlessly, then lowered his head and drank another glass of water, and then sighed heavily.
"Hey! Don't tell me everythingAre all those who surpass themselves systematic? What about my system? Is the shipping address not filled in? Or was it intercepted by a deliveryman? "
“It’s been eighteen years! Even if there is a traffic jam, it’s time to arrive, right? System, system? Do you know that I will wait for you until the flowers have faded? The flowers have faded! Do you know..."
Just when Lin Daoran was complaining about everything, there was a sudden sound in his ears.
Ding!
[It is detected that the host is over 18 years old and has reached adulthood. The anti-addiction mechanism has failed and the monastic plug-in system has been turned on]
Huh?
"Is it my imagination? Or do I think the system is experiencing auditory hallucinations? "
After five seconds, Lin Daoran became angry: "You stupid system has anti-addiction settings? Aren't you afraid that I won't survive until the anti-addiction wears off? Moreover, a certain anti-addiction game allows people to play it for an hour every day, and your system has been silent for eighteen years! Eighteen years! Do you know how I have lived these eighteen years? I *******”
The little man in Lin Daoran's heart was buzzing like a Gatling with blue fire, and he cursed the system for more than ten seconds. Only then did Lin Daoran's anger subside. He took a drink of water and began to study the system!
"System, what is your role? Is there any gift package for newbies? "
[The host can obtain merit points through actions such as subduing demons and saving souls. Merit points can be loaded with a series of plug-ins in the system to assist the host in practicing Taoism. 】
[Open the novice gift package! 】
